name: @aibytes/app-core
description: Logic aibytes.io and the Chrome extension share: ranking, feed visibility, dates, browser storage, saves, the Saved list, the account store and merge. Pure modules; no React.

scripts.test:rules: if command -v firebase >/dev/null && command -v java >/dev/null; then firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-aibytes "node --test --test-concurrency=1 src/accountSaves.test.js"; else echo "test:rules skipped: needs the Firebase CLI and Java"; fi
